title: District Plan (Appendix A)
previewText: The District Plan for the Special South Richmond Development District shows the open space network, designated open space, waterfront esplanade, and building setback lines. The elements of the District Plan are set forth in Appendix A, which is hereby incorporated as an integral part of the provisions of this Chapter.
